name: llm-rl-playground
description: Drive the RL gym over MCP: list coding tasks, submit sandboxed solutions, and run the reward-hacking QA.
long_description: A miniature RL-data workflow exposed over the Model Context Protocol. The bundled stdio server lets any MCP host (Claude Desktop, the MCP Inspector) list coding tasks, fetch a task's public spec, submit a Python solution that is graded sandboxed against held-out tests, and run the reward-hacking QA suite. Grading and anti-cheat are unchanged — the server is only a standard doorway onto functions that already exist in the repo. Held-out tests and expected outputs never leave the sandbox.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the coding tasks available in the gym.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get a task's spec and PUBLIC example cases (held-out tests are never returned).

tools.name: submit_solution
tools.description: Run a Python solution sandboxed against held-out tests; returns reward + signals.

tools.name: run_qa
tools.description: Run the reward-hacking QA suite; returns each exploit's reward (all should be ~0).

python_path.title: Python executable
python_path.description: Path to a Python 3.11+ interpreter that has the `mcp` package installed (e.g. your project's .venv/bin/python, or after `pip install mcp`). Defaults to `python` on your PATH.
